claims.says: Before an update changes the database Aplos saves a copy in the data folder and deletes it after 14 days; a damaged database's copy is kept 30 days; these copies can hold dropped text; removing an account deletes all of them

evidence.ref: apps/desktop/src/host/damaged.ts (PR #567): writeBackup writes mail.db.pre-<from> (VACUUM INTO, mode 0600) in the data folder before a migration and removes older backups; setAside copies a damaged file into damaged/ (0600); pruneCopies, after every healthy start, keeps the newest backup only while younger than BACKUP_DAYS = 14 and removes damaged copies older than DAMAGED_DAYS = 30. account removal on the desktop host calls deleteLocalCopies after the account's rows are gone, with a mark file so an interrupted purge finishes at the next start (PR #567 at 422b5a03)
